text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. It is also important to get enough sleep, because good rest helps you think clearly and feel better. Mental health matters too, so make time to relax and talk to friends or family when you feel worried. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by setting limits and enjoying your free time. Small daily habits can make a big difference to your health.
